core_obligations: The author constructs substrate-boundary Lyapunov functions, proves model-specific finite-time accessibility and minorization, and applies the complete stated quasi-stationary criterion to obtain uniqueness within the exact moment class and both conditioned and unconditioned exponential estimates.
